assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry) is medically necessary
The service is intended to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The payer's denial was under Reason Code CO-197 for missing prior authorization
The service was rendered to document the clinical indication and remains appealable within the filing deadline
